cites: S3.4 body: national UNRATE vintage depth
data.unrate_alfred_vintages.spec: distinct ALFRED realtime_start dates in the raw UNRATE vintage cache, i.e. how many genuinely different point-in-time snapshots of the series exist over its history

realtime.evans_divergent.cross_check: sahm_evans_summary.csv: n_divergent where rule=='EVANS' and protocol=='published'
realtime.evans_divergent.spec: the 2012-14 Federal Reserve forward-guidance threshold -- the FOMC's public commitment to hold its policy rate near zero at least as long as unemployment stayed above 6.5%, operationalised here as the 3mo-avg UNRATE rising to/above 6.5% (EVANS is this arm's internal code identifier only; the manuscript names the FOMC threshold, not a person) -- real-time onsets on which accuracy-tied models disagree, under the 'published' protocol (2 published + 1 forecast month). AS-OF basis: the realized signal at each decision month t is recomputed on the single ALFRED vintage current when month t was first published; the model path trains on the vintage current the day before (the origin vintage) and takes its two published months and, for the Sahm rule, its previous-12-month reference low from that same origin vintage -- only month t itself is model-produced. The companion field each_leg_first_release is the same figure under an alternative construct that splices each month's own first release into one series (a mixed-vintage series no determination ever saw), kept for disclosure.

realtime.evans_divergent_all_forecast.cross_check: sahm_evans_summary.csv: n_divergent where rule=='EVANS' and protocol=='all_forecast'
realtime.evans_divergent_all_forecast.spec: SAME as realtime.evans_divergent but under the retired 'all_forecast' protocol (3 consecutive model nowcasts) -- the before/after contrast, never a result on its own

realtime.sahm_divergent.spec: Sahm-rule (3mo-avg UNRATE rises >=0.50pp above the minimum of the 3mo-avg over the previous 12 months, t-12..t-1, Sahm 2019) real-time onsets on which accuracy-tied models disagree, under the 'published' protocol (2 published + 1 forecast month). AS-OF basis: the realized signal at each decision month t is recomputed on the single ALFRED vintage current when month t was first published; the model path trains on the vintage current the day before (the origin vintage) and takes its two published months and, for the Sahm rule, its previous-12-month reference low from that same origin vintage -- only month t itself is model-produced. The companion field each_leg_first_release is the same figure under an alternative construct that splices each month's own first release into one series (a mixed-vintage series no determination ever saw), kept for disclosure.

realtime.sahm_divergent_all_forecast.cross_check: sahm_evans_summary.csv: n_divergent where rule=='SAHM' and protocol=='all_forecast'
realtime.sahm_divergent_all_forecast.spec: SAME as realtime.sahm_divergent but under the retired 'all_forecast' protocol (3 consecutive model nowcasts) -- the before/after contrast, never a result on its own

realtime.sahm_median_spread_mo.spec: Sahm-rule real-time onset divergences (published protocol): median timing spread in months among the tied models' calls, across only the divergent onsets (excludes outright misses, defined as spread>12mo)

realtime.sahm_n_missed.cross_check: sahm_evans_summary.csv: n_missed where rule=='SAHM' and protocol=='published'
realtime.sahm_n_missed.spec: Sahm-rule real-time onset divergences (published protocol): of the n_divergent onsets, how many were an outright MISS by one tied model (timing spread >12mo) rather than a modest within-year timing shift
